meta.name: design-is
meta.description: Audit a design against Dieter Rams' ten "Good design is..." principles, then hand off a /make-plan prompt for one of three outcomes — new design, refine design, or redesign. Use when the user says "audit this design", "design review", "check this UI against Rams", "is this UI good", "critique this design", "design audit", or asks for a critique that should lead to a plan.

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 对照迪特·拉姆斯十大原则审核设计并生成改进方案
copy.fit_line: 适合你，如果你需要依据经典设计原则来评估和优化界面设计。
copy.tagline_en: Audit designs against Dieter Rams' ten principles and generate improvement plans
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you need to evaluate and improve interface designs based on classic design principles.

howto.what: Claude 会用 Dieter Rams 十项原则逐条评审你的设计,每条给出 0–3 分与证据、总分和结论(新做/改进/重做),并产出一份可直接粘贴的 /make-plan 提示。
howto.when: 当你说「audit this design」「design review」等关键词,或要求一次最终能产出计划的设计评审时触发。常规 UI 代码审查和单纯改文案不归它管。

say.text: 审计这个设计:主要用户是第一次来的人,主任务是下单。
say.note: 先写 00-scope.md 锁定评审范围

say.text: 按 Rams 十项原则给这个页面打分,同一模式取最差的那处。
say.note: 每个原则要附 file:line 证据

say.text: 按这次审计的结论,生成一份 /make-plan 提示。

howto.what_en: Claude audits your design against Dieter Rams' ten principles, scores each 0–3 with cited evidence, gives a total and a verdict (new, refine, or redesign), and writes a copy-pasteable /make-plan prompt.
howto.when_en: Triggers when you say "audit this design", "design review", etc., or ask for a critique that should lead to a plan. Routine UI code reviews and copy edits are out of scope.

say_en.text: Audit this design; the primary user is a first-time visitor and the main task is checkout.
Score this page against Rams' ten principles, taking the worst instance of a pattern.
say_en.note: Every principle needs a file:line citation

say_en.text: Turn this audit's verdict into a /make-plan prompt.
